name: Beachbum's Tiger Milk Batter
description: Jeff 'Beachbum' Berry's adaptation of Don the Beachcomber's Hot Tiger's Milk batter: 4 parts coconut cream, 1 part softened butter, 1 part clover honey.
instructions: Soften the butter at room temperature.
Combine 4 parts coconut cream with 1 part softened butter and 1 part clover honey until smooth.
